description.value:
Whether you were the subject of a secret government experiment, medical malpractice, or wanted to enhance your own capabilities, you've become infused with self-replicating nanomachines that can heal your otherwise organic body. Over the years, you've learned how to maintain these molecular-sized medical marvels, forming a symbiotic bond with the nanite swarm.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and the other one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Medicine skill and the Technology Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Nanomedical Safeguards] skill feat.
